export_pattern: Pinned native export with the captured task environment, stdout and stderr to regular files, then info.id identity verification. No model endpoint invoked.
terminal_gates: Completed actual RECEIPT with ended_at_utc and exit_code
Starting and current project inventories match before/after receipt
Unique session ID from emitted events or retained native creation log
